extracted_information: The article details a user-mode rootkit technique to hide processes in Windows by injecting a custom DLL and hooking the NtQuerySystemInformation API. This method conceals processes from tools like Task Manager and Process Hacker.

specifications.mechanism_of_hiding: Manipulating NextEntryOffset in SYSTEM_PROCESS_INFORMATION to remove the hidden process from the linked list of processes returned by the hooked API.
specifications.dll_injection_privilege_requirement: Administrator or NT AUTHORITY SYSTEM privileges (for injecting into protected processes like Task Manager)

features: Utilizes a custom Dynamic Link Library (DLL) for injection.
Intercepts and modifies the output of the NtQuerySystemInformation function.
Filters out specified processes from the system's process list.
Achieves process concealment by altering data structures in memory before they are returned to requesting applications.
Demonstrated effectiveness against standard Windows process monitoring tools.
